See [studio-create.ts](</Users/nickdejesus/Code/nimbus/packages/cli/src/app/reviews/studio-create.ts:34>) and [ui-proxy.ts](</Users/nickdejesus/Code/nimbus/packages/cli/src/app/reviews/ui-proxy.ts:764>). - The launch action contract is reusable unchanged. Adoption stays user-facing as `adopt`, creates an isolated worktree or branch, and refuses active/non-ready sessions.
